g.text: No other part of the same size costs the recall as much as the J++ part
Extra loss (0-1): switches lost without the part, minus those lost without a random part
(same size). Recall with 95% CI; % = the part's share of the change. Random atoms: a dictionary
of random atoms, picked by the same OMP at its own share.
J++ part and PCA directions: one-pick scenes (only the asked pick changes).
The other two panels: main test (two people swap picks).
